title: What the Slow Loris guards

is_this_you.pressure: Trouble comes and you go still. Watchers think you froze. You are choosing your words, and your moment.
is_this_you.love: You let a person in one branch at a time. By the time they see the gate, they are behind it.
is_this_you.cost: You test people in silence instead of asking. Most never learn they sat an exam, or that they failed it.

opener.text: In Borneo, people told researchers that slow lorises kept the gate of heaven [S7]. Each person had a loris of their own, waiting there after death [S7]. Picture it. A small animal with enormous eyes. A threshold in the dark. No hurry at all. The rest of this reading is about what you guard.

rows.text: Scorpio is fixed Water, ruled by Mars in the old books and Pluto in the new [S1]. The Snake is yin Fire, calm and observant, a deep thinker [S3]. Both halves are yin. So your heat stays under the surface, and few people ever see it rise.

The slow loris moves slowly along the vines and does not leap [S11]. Researchers think it may mimic the spectacled cobra, its hunched arms working like a hood [S6]. A Snake-year animal in a snake's shape. You also carry more warning than your size suggests.

tabs.label: What you keep in reserve
tabs.intro: What you hold back is the point.

rows.text: Hunters in Mondulkiri, Cambodia, said a loris that fell could heal its own broken bones at once [S7]. You keep that kind of reserve. You fall, you set the bone yourself, and others hear about it later, if at all.
The Snake's old weaknesses are suspicion and possessiveness [S3]. Left alone, the guard stays on duty long after the danger has gone home.

tabs.label: Who gets past the gate
tabs.intro: Three may come in. One waits outside.
tabs.love_lead: You watch a person for a long time from the far branch. You need someone who will not rush you or laugh at the shyness.

tabs.label: Your craft
tabs.intro: Work where patience is the skill.

rows.text: Choose work where depth beats speed. Fraud review and archive work both pay for the long, still look you were born with.

easy.why: The Asian Elephant (Cancer, Ox year) shares your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster, and Cancer is Water like you [S3] [S1].
The Mandarin Dragonet (Pisces, Rooster year) closes that trine, and Pisces is the third Water sign [S3] [S1].
The Snowy Owl (Capricorn, Monkey year) is your secret friend, since the Monkey is the Snake's hidden ally [S3].

hard.why: The hard one is the Golden Snub-nosed Monkey (Leo, Pig year), because the Pig clashes with the Snake [S3].

story.text: In Indonesia the slow loris is called malu malu, the shy one [S7]. All slow lorises are protected under CITES Appendix I, and the Javan slow loris is Critically Endangered [S11].

closing: The ones you guard sleep through nights they never knew were dangerous.
